Willet self-reports a preference for exactly this kind of work and posts a marginally higher Extraction & Retrieval eval (79.2 vs. 81.6 — actually Lapwing leads here within variance), so the routing rests primarily on task-type fit with Willet's preferences. Since neither model's eval edge exceeds the 2.0-point variance threshold, aligning the task with the model's self-reported preference (and avoiding routing aversive open-ended work) is the tiebreaker.
